rt.title: Requirement tasks
rt.consent.text: Deliveries of requirement tasks (including session transcripts, decisions and manual edits) are uploaded to the self-evolution server to improve the development process. You need to agree before receiving tasks.
rt.empty: No tasks assigned to me yet
rt.st.reworkedTo: Sent back to "{step}"; this step is on hold
rt.receive.done: Materials are in place; confirm the prompt to start the task
rt.start.hint: An interactive task will start with workflow {bp}; you may edit the prompt.
rt.start.bpMissing: Workflow {id} is not installed on this machine: install it from the marketplace first
rt.deliver.wizard: Review what to deliver in the cancong share wizard
rt.rework.attach: Attach the current output (e.g. a test report)
rt.err.consent: Please agree to the notice above first
rt.err.notOwner: This step is not assigned to you
rt.err.notReady: This step cannot be received yet
rt.err.notCurrent: This is no longer the current step
rt.err.notClaimer: Only the machine that received this step can do this
rt.err.reworkTarget: You can only send back to an earlier step
rt.err.cwd: The working directory must be an absolute path
rt.err.noServer: No self-evolution server address (set one in Settings, or connect cancong to the operations dashboard)
rt.err.tooLarge: The package is too large; untick some items in the wizard
rt.err.diskFull: The server disk is full; contact the admin
rt.err.uiNotConnected: The cancong main window is not open, so the interactive task cannot start
rt.err.projectFull: A task is already running in this directory
rt.err.blueprintMissing: The workflow does not exist; install it first
